card.name: The word Spirit after Holy
card.fires_on: The word Spirit when it names the Holy Spirit in theological writing, mostly right after "Holy". It also fires on Spirit after "his" or "The" when the Holy Spirit is meant.

modes.label: Holy Spirit
modes.description: Spirit directly after Holy in religious or Bible-study text.

modes.label: Spirit without Holy
modes.description: Spirit after his or The, still referring to the divine Spirit.
